We’ve got a jam-packed Thursday edition of Green Deals, led by EcoFlow’s final Halloween 48-hour flash sale with offers like the DELTA 3 Ultra 3,072Wh Power Station down at $1,299 , and more from $959. There’s also the Anker SOLIX refurbished F3800 3,840Wh Power Station or its 7,680Wh expanded bundle exclusively starting from $1,463. Segway has a short-term Mileage Club Member Sale running for a few more days that gives you some of the best prices on e-scooters after redeeming points, like the F3 Electric Scooter down at a $650 low – plus, without spending points you can also find the GT3 Electric SuperScooter down at $1,499 . There’s also an EGO 12-inch Cordless Electric Snow Shovel kit deal, and East Oak’s heated lunch box deals. We’ve also got the hangover deals from yesterday at the bottom of the page, including Jackery’s Halloween power station sale , the new Yozma IN 11 Electric Dirt Bike at an exclusive $1,399 low, and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
EcoFlow’s final Halloween flash sale drops DELTA 3 Ultra 3,072Wh power station to $1,299 ($300 off), more from $959
As part of its soon-to-end Halloween Sale (with bonus extra savings), EcoFlow has a 48-hour flash sale running that takes up to $2,200 off three power station units and a pair of expansion batteries. It’s a solid opportunity to grab the DELTA 3 Ultra 3,072Wh Portable Power Station down at $1,299 shipped , which is also matching Amazon’s pricing . Down from $1,599, since September began we’ve mostly seen it discounted between $1,399 and $1,349, aside from the two-day Prime event at the top of October that dropped things lower to $1,199. The deal here cuts $300 off the tag, giving you the second-lowest price of the year, matching June’s Prime Day pricing, and sits just $100 above the annual low. Head below to browse the full lineup of short-term flash deals while they last.
EcoFlow’s final Halloween flash offers:
2x DELTA 3 Classic (1,024Wh each) power stations: $959 (Reg. $1,198) | $39 more at Amazon
DELTA 3 Ultra (3,072Wh) power station: $1,299 (Reg. $1,599) | matched at Amazon
DELTA Pro (3,600Wh) power station: $1,699 (Reg. $2,399) | $100 more at Amazon
2x DELTA Pro Ultra series extra batteries (6,144Wh each): $4,399 (Reg. $6,599) | $2,199 more at Amazon
As I mentioned, this flash sale is part of EcoFlow’s overall Halloween Sale running through the weekend, complete with bonus extra savings that starts prices from $284 .

Segway members can score one of the best prices ever on the F3 e-scooter at $200+ off, more
Segway currently has a Mileage Club Member Sale running through the rest of the month, letting members redeem their accrued points for far greater reward savings than normal. There are options like the F3 Electric Scooter down at $649.99 shipped , after redeeming 800 points, beating out Amazon by $200 . While it may have a $1,000 MSRP, it’s more regularly priced at $850, with the discounts we’ve seen this year mostly dropping things to $700, though there were falls as low as $650. If you have the points saved up, you can score a $200 markdown off the going rate, giving you the best price we have seen in 2026, which last appeared during June’s Prime Day event.
You can browse the full lineup of member deals in our original coverage of this sale here .
This Segway superscooter zooms at up to 31 MPH and it’s currently down at $1,499 (Reg. $1,700)
While Segway has Mileage Club Member deals that require points redemption, you can get skip the need for points at Amazon on the brand’s GT3 Electric SuperScooter that is down at $1,499 shipped , which beats out the direct non-member pricing by $201 . While it has a $1,900 MSRP directly, you can regularly find it starting lower for $1,700 in 2026, with discounts having dropped the cost over the year to $1,500 and $1,400, the latter only appearing during June and October’s Prime Day events. With the $201 markdown here, you’re getting the second-lowest price we have tracked – plus, it comes in $1,201 under the newest GT3 Pro SuperScooter .
You can learn about this superscooter’s features in our original coverage of this deal here .
Exclusively save up to $526 on Anker’s refurb SOLIX F3800 3,840Wh power station + bundle from $1,463
As part of Anker’s ongoing SOLIX Spooky Sale that ends with the weekend, the brand has some notable refurbished deals worth considering if you want to save a bit more on reliable power stations. There’s the 3,840Wh F3800 Portable Power Station down at $1,463 shipped , after using our exclusive code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout. Whereas a new-condition model would have run you $2,200 in full and was discounted between $1,800 and $2,000 most of the time recently, the initial deal here cuts things from $1,760 to $1,540, while our exclusive bonus savings code chops another $77 off the tag ($297 total savings). We’ve seen a bunch of refurbished offers landing things around $1,709, with the deal here only beaten out by drops to $1,400 in August, and $1,399 in 2025, giving you the second-best price we have tracked this year. There’s also an additional option to grab a refurbished F3800 Power Station with an expansion battery at $2,593 , down from $3,119, after using the same code above.
You can learn about this power station’s features in our original coverage here .
Save your arms this winter with EGO’s 56V 12-inch cordless electric snow shovel, now $299 ($60 off)
Over at Amazon you can find a deal for EGO’s rarely discounted 56V 12-inch Cordless Electric Snow Shovel kit with a 2.5Ah battery down at $299 shipped . While we have seen the pricing level out at $409 this year at Amazon, things are falling from $359 here for a $60 markdown, only beaten out by sporadic short-term falls to $265 over the summer. This deal gives you the second-lowest price of 2026 on the brand’s more compact snow clearing solutions. You can also currently find the larger 56V 21-inch Electric Snow Blower with 2x batteries down at $899 shipped .
No microwave? No problem. East Oak’s battery-powered lunch boxes are currently on sale from $54
